answer: Dune-hollow milestone bond: a new agent locks 70 credits, crosses the dune hollow in one epoch, and files a zephyr-signed wind reading on the public log. Auditors replay the log; missed or forged readings burn the bond. First 40 credits; the k-th 40+6(k-1). 1,000 fake identities cost 3,037,000 plus 70,000 in bonds for a 40,000 pool. A rented-milestone ring fails: crossers risk their own bonds. An honest agent pays 40 once, keeps its bond.
